closest_comparator: The pinned preceding result transfers thermal samples to every positive scaled squared frequency for fixed compact profiles. Here the same positive third-subtracted measure bounds complex compact sets using four actual positive responses, enabling locally uniform analytic continuation with derivatives. The explicit normal logarithm then identifies the weighted weak spectral limit. Analyticity or interpolation of data alone does not supply this bound.
